newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia stocks down 2.54 pct on central bank news.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia stocks down 2.54 pct on central bank news.

text.p: Malaysian blue-chip stocks plunged 2.54 percent on Wednesday afternoon following a statement from central Bank Negara saying it will defend the ringgit against currency speculators, analysts said.
At 0718 GMT the benchmark Composite Index had shed 26.86 points, or 2.54 percent, to 1,030.91.
"I'm almost certain the market has reacted to the news that Bank Negara may increase interest rates," said an analyst at a foreign brokerage house.
